canary_gate.purpose: One static then one dependency-bound dynamic atom on each exact route, each in its own fresh native Goal.
required_before_launch: all four direct-file DAG contracts independently pass
new materializer, controller projection, and verifier are implemented and mechanically reviewed
six atom files and task identities are predeclared
no prior direct-DAG canary attempt exists
canary_gate.success_authority: A separate fresh review may decide only whether matrix 007 preflight is admissible.

controller.empirical_transport: Root Codex collaboration tools only; no Python or external process may claim to execute collaboration.
controller.failure_action: Stop the matrix at first mismatch; mark every remaining atom unlaunched; never retry or relaunch.
controller.scheduling: Deterministic cell-index, route, dependency-depth, atom-id order; at most one active atom per route.

loop_breaker.on_repeated_normalized_family: Freeze that family and pivot without stopping the root Goal.
